Hello, I'm a newbie and I'm looking for some new characters to draw! I like your work and that's why I want you to draw two of my original characters.

Male: 185 tall, light skinned

Jun AKAHO

Appearance judgment is male, about 22 years of human age, height 185, hair mostly black, with a small portion of hair with a large red color, which he describes as naturally occurring, but it is difficult to guarantee the authenticity of this description.
His favorite food is fluffy meat pine bread.


Female: Height 170, poor breasts, buttocks and thighs a little thick.

Jun AKAHO

She is 18-19 years old, 170 cm tall, with mostly black hair and a large mixture of red color.
Her first impression is expressionless.
Her favorite food is strawberries, and her favorite desserts are strawberry barfi and strawberry cake, but she does not eat much sweet food.
She does not like chili peppers.
She is a strong drinker, but doesn't really like to drink, she just "needs" to. If it wasn't illegal, she might try taking "pills" for work.
She is a writer by profession, but what she writes is pretty unimpressive. She cries out, "Why am I the only one with no talent?"

Feel free to pick out clothes and stuff.
Please note the moles under their eyes and the red part in their hair.
If the amount is not enough, please adjust it.

すみません。こちら側のミスに気づきまして、再送させて頂きます！
SIRU様の絵の雰囲気や絵柄が大好きです！
良ければ私の創作キャラ2人を描いて頂きたいです。

【キャラ詳細】
Googleドライブにキャラ資料を添付しています。お目通しいただけますと幸いです。

▶︎鈴木 青
男/黒髪/ややつり目/タレ眉/黒メガネ/青ジャージ/168cm（自称）/18歳
苦学生。真面目で正直な性格から友達がいない。大人しそうな見た目だが、仲良くなると口調が強めで方言もある。身長が低いことを気にしているため牛乳を飲むことが多い。彩人に対してツンデレな事がある。

▶︎柊 彩人
男/黒髪/ジト目/三白眼/顔に傷跡/ピアス多め/186cm/29歳
職業不詳。発言が軽く対応も軽い。基本的に無表情だが、青の前では少し表情豊か。性格や趣味、笑い方など全てが変。ヘビースモーカー。ブラックコーヒーが好き。距離が近い。愛（友愛）が重め。


描いていただきたいのは、
･メガネのキャラクターがジャージメイド服（ジャージは青色）の衣装を着ている。表情は「呆れている」or「照れて嫌がっている」
･傷跡のあるキャラクターが、それを「面白がっている」or「可愛いと思って真剣な顔で見ている」 というシチュエーションでお願いしたいです！
構図についてはお任せいたします。 SIRU様の明るくて可愛い雰囲気の絵柄がとても好きなので、そのテイストで描いていただけると嬉しいです。
ご検討のほど、よろしくお願いいたします！

Hello, Sensei. It's a pleasure to meet you for the first time. 🤝 I'm an overseas fan, and this is my first time using Skeb. I absolutely adore your artworks—they’re amazing! 🥰 I’d be over the moon if you could draw my OC couple. 😊

⚫️ Female (younger sister): 17 years old, 165cm tall, with pink hair and brown eyes. She’s incredibly cute, with big eyes, a slim and petite build. She openly shows her love for her brother, sticks to him all the time, and loves to act coquettishly around him.

⚫️ Male (older brother): 19 years old, 188cm tall, with black hair and black eyes. He has long lower eyelashes, a tall and athletic build (he’s trained in sports). He’s not good at expressing himself, speaks very little, but quietly dotes on his sister and shows his care through actions.
